name: Keyzia
positioning: A French platform for deploying AI use cases across a real estate or construction company, with European hosting and a per-address data layer.
description: Keyzia is a French application that lets a real estate or construction company test, deploy and centralise its AI use cases in one place rather than leaving them scattered across individual accounts. It is sold to estate agents, property administrators and syndics, tradespeople and renovators, banks and insurers, and energy actors, each with its own set of prepared uses: preparing a full listing mandate, analysing quotes and invoices, energy diagnosis, risk and green-value assessment. A module called KeyPark holds a portfolio of addresses with the history attached to each property, covering past transactions, works and diagnostics, with notifications when something changes. An interactive map layer adds address-level data for spotting projects on a territory. The vendor states data is hosted in Europe.
real_estate_use: The AI problem inside a French agency or syndic is not that nobody uses it, it is that everyone uses it separately, in a personal account, with client data. Keyzia is positioned against exactly that: it puts the prepared use cases in one company tool, integrated where the teams already work, so the practice becomes shared rather than hidden. For an agent, the working moment is preparing a mandate: the property's transaction history, its diagnostics, its past works and its surroundings pulled together in minutes instead of an afternoon of portal-hopping. For a property administrator, it is watching a stock of buildings and anticipating which ones will need renovation work. European hosting is a purchase criterion in this market, not a detail.
features: Centralised catalogue of AI use cases deployable across a company
Integration into the business tools the teams already use
KeyPark address portfolio with per-property history of transactions, works and diagnostics
Interactive territory map enriched with address-level data

use_cases.job: Assemble a complete listing mandate from a property's history and surroundings in minutes
Watch a stock of buildings and anticipate which need renovation work
Assess a property's risk and energy value without ordering a study

capabilities: Prepared business use cases for real estate and construction
